subject: Renewal: term & capacity uplift — legal redlines and execution plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Sherman <anna.sherman@cloudfolio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal: term & capacity uplift — legal redlines and execution plan

Anna — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, CloudFolio is ready to move forward with the renewal and a capacity uplift but we need to align on a few redlines before legal can circulate the execution copy. High-level summary of asks from your side and our proposed path: 

- Term: you requested 36 months; your procurement ops prefers 24 months. Redwood can offer a 24-month base with a prepaid 12-month option to achieve the longer commitment profile (we included pricing for both in the proforma).
- Capacity: increase from 6 reserved units to 20 reserved units (same GPU spec). Exhibit B needs a clean capacity schedule and a burst policy for transient spikes.
- SLA credits and plan: you asked for stronger latency SLOs for the new reserved pool; our legal is OK to tighten SLOs if we limit the commitment to the dedicated pool and add a small monthly performance credit cap.
- Data retention / audit logs: you want a 3-year retention for audit logs; Redwood typically provides 1 year by default. Legal will propose a scoped Exhibit on audit export frequency and search retention for security reviews.

I've attached our proposed redline (CloudFolio_Renewal_Proposed_Redline.docx) and the updated Exhibit B (ExhibitB_Capacity_Schedule_v3.xlsx) with the capacity ladder and prorated ramp. Marcus, Kim — can you please review the redline and flag any non-starters by EOD Thursday so we can keep the signature timeline?

Requested next steps:
- CloudFolio to confirm final term (24 vs 36) by end of week.
- Redwood legal (Kimberly) to run the redline and flag items that need C-level approval.
- Finance (Marcus) to prepare a prorated invoice and payment schedule for the uplift (pricing-proforma-q3.pdf attached).

Anna — if everything looks good we’ll send a DocuSign packet with the clean MSA + order form by Monday and aim to have countersignature the following week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
Attachments: CloudFolio_Renewal_Proposed_Redline.docx (docx), ExhibitB_Capacity_Schedule_v3.xlsx (xlsx), pricing-proforma-q3.pdf (pdf)
From: Anna Sherman <anna.sherman@cloudfolio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudfolio.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: term & capacity uplift — legal redlines and execution plan

Jordan — thanks, got this and the attachments. We like the 24 + prepaid 12 approach, that’s probably the path our procurement team will accept. Quick clarifications from our side before we loop legal: 

- Can Redwood confirm lag time for the reserved pool expansion (how many days from countersign to full capacity)?
- Burst capacity: we need a written guarantee about burst availability for 30% over baseline for up to 72 hours. Is that feasible?
- Audit logs retention: we can accept scoped export frequency if we can guarantee on-demand exports to our S3 bucket.

I’ll route the redline to our legal but wanted to confirm the architecture/operational constraints first. If you can respond on the two bullets above I’ll push to get their redline back quickly.

—Anna
Anna Sherman
Director of Cloud Architecture | CloudFolio, Inc.
anna.sherman@cloudfolio.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: term & capacity uplift — legal redlines and execution plan

Thanks Jordan and Anna — quick legal read and play. I reviewed the proposed redline and called out the priority negotiation items inline in the attached DOCX. High-level notes: 

1) Term structure: 24-month firm term with an optional prepay addendum for 12 months is acceptable. We will draft an Addendum that formalizes prepay pricing and the change-of-term mechanics (renewal triggers, early termination fee if below committed utilization).

2) Capacity schedule (Exhibit B): The Exhibit looks fine but we need explicit language on the provisioning SLA. Suggested clause: Redwood will provision the requested reserved capacity within 14 business days of countersign for standard pool expansion; expedited provisioning (7 business days) can be provided if CloudFolio accepts a one-time provisioning surcharge. Marcus — can you confirm the surcharge numbers and mark the proforma accordingly.

3) Burst availability: legal can accept a defined burst policy (30% above baseline for up to 72 hours) but we need an operational cap: burst is subject to global capacity availability and is not a guaranteed SLO. We will add a fallback: if burst is unavailable, Redwood will apply a 5% credit for the impacted billing period. Please advise if CloudFolio will accept that operational cap.

4) Data retention / audit logs: we will offer 3-year exports as a paid add-on with automated monthly snapshots to CloudFolio’s S3 (per request). For on-demand exports we’ll include a service-level response window (48 hours). Security: we will add an Exhibit for export encryption key handling and audit logs access control.

5) SLA credits: we can tighten the latency SLOs for the dedicated pool; however, we cap total monthly credits at 20% of the monthly fee for that pool.

Action items I’ll take on: redline the MSA to reflect the above, produce an Addendum template for the prepay 12-month option, and add the Exhibit on exports. Marcus, please send the updated surcharge and proforma numbers. Jordan — I’ll need CloudFolio’s legal redline back by COB Friday to keep the Monday DocuSign target.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: CloudFolio_Renewal_Proposed_Redline.docx (tracked changes)

- CloudFolio confirmed via phone that 24 + prepaid 12 is acceptable; Anna is routing to their legal now.
- Marcus: please prepare the expedited-provisioning surcharge schedule and a prorated invoice draft for the uplift (attached). We need a number we can include in the DocuSign packet.
- Kimberly: finalize the redline (MSA + Addendum + Exhibit for exports). If CloudFolio’s redline contains minor language tweaks we will accept; anything that materially changes liability or credit caps must be escalated.
